ideas.title: The $250M Minnesota Medicaid Fraud Scheme: An Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the details of the $250M Medicaid fraud scheme in Minnesota, including the individuals and organizations involved.
ideas.angle: Follow the money: tracing the flow of funds in the alleged fraud scheme.
questions: Who was involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and shed light on the individuals and organizations involved.
